title: Nourishing Chinese Tomato Stew
description: A savory and pillowy one-pot Chinese dish featuring diced tomatoes, paleo-friendly and made with papillote for added flavor
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute
Add the diced tomatoes, soy sauce, and sesame oil to the pot, stirring to combine
Cut the papillote paper into a large square and place it on top of the pot, folding the edges to seal
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 20 minutes
Remove the papillote paper and stir in the chopped scallions, salt, and black pepper
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired
Let the stew cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
